To Miss Arundell

Walter Savage Landor (1775–1864)

N
ATURE!
 thou may’st fume and fret,
There’s but one white violet;
Scatter o’er the vernal ground
Faint resemblances around,
Nature! I will tell thee yet
There’s but one white violet.
